spans.s: An epithet of Buddha, son of शुद्धोदन.

a. 
(-द्री f.) [शूद्र-अण्] Relating to a Śūdra or his tribe; शौद्राणि कर्माणि च ब्राह्मणः सन् [[

.]] 
-द्रः The son of a man of any of the first three castes by a Śūdra woman; see [[

सौदामनी,
सौदामिनी, सौदाम्नी 
__1 Lightning; सौदामन्या कनकनिकषस्निग्धया दर्शयोर्वीम् [[

.]] 
__2 The female of Indra's elephant. 
__3 A kind of lightning (forked one); काञ्चनाभं नभश्चक्रे विद्युत्सौदामिनी यथा [[

a. 
(-की f.) Whatever is given to a woman at her marriage by her parents, or a relative [Page1708-1] in general, which becomes her own property; मातृपित्रादिभिर्दत्तं धनं सौदायिकं स्मृतम् [[Śukra. 4. 814.]] 
-कम् A nuptial present so made.
